author: jeroen043
quote: This is the best game ever made for young and old. Played it as a 13 year old in 1998. Now playing it with my 10 year old daughter in 2026. She loves it just as much as i did back in the day. We have the best time playing this gem together.
game_title: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time

author: jeroen043
quote:
We wanted GTA, yet we got a toxic girlfriend simulator. Main character has no personality what so ever. Not enjoying the chores and constanly pleasing the girlboss all the time. I dont feel like roleplaying a simp character. GTA was about being a gangster/criminal, not about being the 'perfect boyfriend'. Lucia is highly inlikeable... cant stand her attitude and behavior, so its extremely unimmersive to play.

Feel like the critics are paid reviewers, I just cant imagine why every single review says 100/100, even if the critics point out its not a perfect game 

Its absolutely nowhere near perfect. Its just bad, really bad for a game that long in development and with a budget of almost 2 billion. Cant believe Rockstar made this garbage. I've been a hardcore GTA fan since the release of the first game in the nineties, but it just lost its identity. Its not a real GTA anymore. Its what a modern HR department would want a GTA to look like. This game is a huge dissapointment.
